title: VR Running
description: It allows people who play VR Minecraft(Vivecraft) to experience runnning as if it were real life.
body:
# Realisic Running For VR
This datapack adds working running for VR.
  This is done with entitys and commands

### How does it works
You just put the datapack into the datapacks folder and enable it if its not already, then just move your hands as if your running.
## Planned Features
- Swappable Sprint
- Hunger Bar
- Optional
- Multiplayer


Currently its best to use this with maps.
  
  
(I recommend using a datapack mod like [this](https://modrinth.com/project/Re6xQ62Z))
